subject.title: fix: require decimal numeric oc-path predicates

question: Should relational oc-path predicates continue accepting every finite JavaScript-number-coercible operand as documented, or should the public CLI deliberately narrow to plain-decimal strings?
rationale: Both choices are supportable, but the branch changes a published CLI behavior contract and repository policy treats compatibility-sensitive public behavior changes as requiring maintainer intent.

options.title: Preserve finite-number coercion
options.body: Keep the current `Number()`-plus-finite check and reject this compatibility-changing branch unless a separate defect is demonstrated.

options.title: Adopt decimal-only predicates
options.body: Accept a deliberate grammar change only with an owner decision, public documentation and upgrade wording, and tests covering the intended accepted and rejected forms.

recommendation.title: Preserve finite-number coercion
recommendation.body: Keep the current `Number()`-plus-finite check and reject this compatibility-changing branch unless a separate defect is demonstrated.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline provides the only concrete maintainer-side routing signal for this public-contract decision.
